name: Andrzej Halicki - § 8 - Am 8
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: 8. Considers, given the mortal train accidents which occurred in Spain during the budgetary period, that the strengthening of maintenance and safety in railway infrastructure, as well as the traceability and accountability of Union funds, are more important and urgent than the proposed increase for the EU Agency for Railways (ERA)9; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 9 Regulation (EU) 2026/1184 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 May 2026 on the use of Railway Infrastructure Capacity in the single European railway area, amending Directive 2012/34/EU and repealing Regulation (EU) No 913/2010 (OJ L, 2026/1184, 10.6,2026, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2026/1184/oj).
